name: full-ta-weight-no-sentiment
rationale: src/backtest/simulator.rs:92 calls TradingEngine::compute_btc_target(point, &[], &trading_config) -- the news slice is always empty in a backtest, so sentiment_normalized is pinned at the constant 0.5 and contributes a fixed sentiment_weight*0.5 = 0.15 offset. With the baseline's ta_weight=0.7 the combined signal can therefore only ever span [0.15, 0.85], while the zone boundaries sit at hold_jpy_below=0.2 / hold_btc_above=0.8: reaching zone A (all-JPY) requires ta_normalized < 0.0714 and zone C (all-BTC) requires ta_normalized > 0.9286, i.e. essentially all five sub-signals saturated in the same direction at once. That compression is a plausible contributor to the muted turnover the 2026-09-08 report kept observing (baseline 36-37 trades over 14 days, ~2.6/day, well under the 4-10/day guideline) and to variants clustering near the middle of the interpolation zone. Setting ta_weight=1.0 / sentiment_weight=0.0 restores the full [0.0, 1.0] range for the TA signal, making both extreme zones reachable. It is also directly meaningful in live operation: NewsAnalyzer falls back to score=0.0 whenever Ollama is unavailable, which produces the same constant-0.5 neutral term, so this variant measures what the strategy does when the sentiment channel is honestly treated as carrying no information rather than as a range-compressing constant.
